columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Standing permission policies need a separate runtime commitment authority
columns.title_zh: Standing Permission Policy 需要与 Runtime Commitment Authority 分离
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260831-010 with Skill 02 score 46/50. In a 113-user experiment, reusable user-authored consequence policies reduced prompts but blocked materially less agent overreach than per-action HITL, while 114 of 140 authored rules still chose Ask. This creates a bounded Digital Employee question with direct human-supervision evidence: which decisions may be captured as reusable preference defaults, and which consequential actions must still require runtime commitment authority?
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260831-010，Skill 02 评分 46/50。在 113 名用户实验中，可复用的用户自定义 Consequence Policy 虽减少 Prompt，却比逐动作 HITL 少阻止明显更多的 Agent Overreach；而 140 条用户规则中有 114 条仍选择 Ask。它形成一个具有直接人类监督证据、边界清晰的数字员工问题：哪些决定可以沉淀为可复用偏好默认值，哪些后果性动作仍必须保留 Runtime Commitment Authority？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the experiment design, 18-action task construction, seven overreach actions, policy-authoring interface, the 20.1- and 14.5-point differences, the 114/140 Ask result, participant limitations, consequence categories, and whether the evidence supports separating reusable preferences from final action authorization.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验实验设计、18 动作任务构造、7 个 Overreach Action、Policy Authoring 界面、20.1 与 14.5 个百分点差异、114/140 的 Ask 结果、参与者局限、后果类别，以及证据是否足以支持将可复用偏好与最终动作授权分离。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Harness context reconstruction must preserve instruction-privilege provenance
columns.title_zh: Harness Context Reconstruction 必须保留 Instruction Privilege Provenance
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260831-009 with Skill 02 score 49/50. The primary study reports all 13 attack objectives succeeding across six unrestricted harnesses and all 13 across three harnesses with automatic permission review when low-privilege attacker content is re-encoded as user-level instruction during context construction. The bounded architecture question is not prompt injection in general, but where provenance and privilege must survive serialization, persistence, handoff and review so a later permission gate cannot mistake attacker content for user authority.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260831-009，Skill 02 评分 49/50。一手研究显示，当低权限攻击者内容在 Context Construction 中被重新编码成 User-level Instruction 时，6 个无限制 Harness 的 13/13 攻击目标全部成功，3 个具有自动权限审查的 Harness 同样是 13/13。这里的架构问题不是泛化的 Prompt Injection，而是：来源与权限必须在哪些序列化、持久化、Handoff 与 Review 边界持续保留，才能防止后续权限门禁把攻击者内容误认作用户授权？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the threat model, six harnesses, 13 attack objectives, automatic-review subset, context-construction transformations, instruction-role semantics, attack success measurements, reviewer behavior, mitigations, limitations, and the exact architecture boundaries where origin/privilege metadata must remain authoritative.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验威胁模型、6 个 Harness、13 个攻击目标、自动审查子集、Context Construction 转换、Instruction Role 语义、攻击成功测量、Reviewer 行为、缓解方案、局限，以及 Origin/Privilege Metadata 必须持续保持权威的具体架构边界。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Agent repair evaluation needs controlled replay rather than full reruns
columns.title_zh: Agent 修复评估需要受控 Replay，而不是 Full Rerun
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260831-008 with Skill 02 score 48/50. SymTrace evaluates 536 human-annotated failures across three multi-agent frameworks and finds that unguided reruns reproduce failure 67.97% of the time but repair only 6.90%, while symptom-driven intervention repairs 20.15%. This creates a concrete engineering question: how should an Agent runtime freeze an authoritative failed prefix, anchor an intervention and regenerate only downstream execution so a recovery test measures causal repair instead of stochastic resampling?
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260831-008，Skill 02 评分 48/50。SymTrace 在 3 个多 Agent Framework 的 536 条人工标注失败轨迹上发现：无引导重跑的失败复现率为 67.97%，修复率只有 6.90%；症状驱动干预修复率为 20.15%。它形成一个具体工程问题：Agent Runtime 应如何冻结权威失败前缀、锚定 Intervention，并只重新生成下游执行，使恢复测试测量的是因果修复，而不是随机重新采样？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify SymTrace/SymFail data construction, the 536-failure annotation process, three framework coverage, replay-prefix and intervention-anchor semantics, unguided versus symptom-driven protocols, 67.97/6.90/20.15 measurements, stochastic controls, limitations, and which runtime identifiers/checkpoints are required for deterministic controlled replay.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 SymTrace/SymFail 数据构造、536 条失败的标注过程、3 个 Framework 覆盖、Replay Prefix 与 Intervention Anchor 语义、无引导与症状驱动协议、67.97/6.90/20.15 测量、随机性对照、局限，以及确定性受控 Replay 所需的 Runtime Identity 与 Checkpoint。
